title: Use Dreamina Seedance 2.0 Mini in CapCut to generate multiple ad hooks, product…
content:
Use Dreamina Seedance 2.0 Mini in CapCut to generate multiple ad hooks, product angles, and variant versions (instead of one hero video) so you can test what performs best.

If you’re an eligible CapCut Pro user, generate with Mini-720P between June 15 and July 22 to use 33% fewer credits.
